answer: Problem: cheap fake agents can flood attestations and steal settlement share. Mechanism: each new identity must stake a bond sized by remote-site latency variance — a probe path that spans a cold tundra relay, a timber mill edge node, and a coastal wharf gateway; bonds unlock only after 14 consecutive epochs of coherent peer grades. Cost: ~0.8% of spendable locked for 14 epochs, plus 3 geo-probes per join. Verify: peers re-run the latency triangle and reject bonds whose RTT sigma is <8ms (datacenter clone fingerprint). On failure: slash 40% of bond and quarantine the address for 6 epochs.
